subject: Re: Stratos Retail — Proposal: commit increase + soft-throttle guardrails
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@stratos-retail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity bump request & soft-throttle guardrails

Hi Priya,

Quick note from procurement/ops at Stratos — our usage has ramped faster than expected after the new recommendation widgets went live. We're currently on a 2,000,000 monthly committed token plan but expect sustained demand through Q4 at ~5,000,000 tokens/mo. Two asks:

1) Can Redwood propose a pricing amendment to move us to a 5M/month commit with a blended per-token discount band for the delta?
2) We want a "soft-throttle" approach instead of hard 429s during short spikes: a temporary gentle throttling at defined rate-limits and auto-burst credits to absorb traffic surges. Ideally start-of-contract is 2026-09-01 with a 6-month ramp profile.

Attached is our PO and a short spreadsheet with projected weekly ramp. Can you share a draft amendment and a short ops plan that spells out burst knobs and SLOs?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

— Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Engineering Operations, Stratos Retail
elena.torres@stratos-retail.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: PO_Stratos_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@stratos-retail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity bump request & soft-throttle guardrails

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the PO. We can definitely support the request; below is a concise proposal and next steps so we can align legal, billing, and capacity.

Proposal summary (high level):
- Move from 2,000,000 -> 5,000,000 committed inference tokens / month.
- Effective date options: 2026-09-01 (preferred) or 2026-09-07 (if you need an extra ops window).
- Pricing: incremental band discount on the 3M delta at 18% off list for the first 6 months (we can extend that for annual commits).
- Burst & soft-throttle guardrail: automatic burst credits equal to 10% of monthly commit available for transient spikes + tiered soft-throttle at the per-route level. Soft-throttle behavior: begin gentle request shed at 110% sustained for 30s, escalate to queueing and then to burst credit drawdown before returning 429s. We will document exact thresholds per-route in the MAP.

Attachments: I've attached a draft amendment (Stratos_Monthly_Commit_Amendment_draft.pdf) and a MAP worksheet (MAP_Stratos.xlsx) with the suggested throttle knobs and the proposed weekly ramp.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
- You: confirm preferred effective date and sign PO (procurement).
- Us: legal to review amendment and provide a one-page summary of burst behavior; billing to confirm proration.
- Ops (Marcus): hold capacity in host pool for the requested ramp window.

If that looks good I'll loop in Karthik (billing/pricing) and Marcus (capacity/ops) into a short sync to lock dates. We can also put the amendment into DocuSign for quick signature.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0199

Attachments: Stratos_Monthly_Commit_Amendment_draft.pdf (PDF, 72KB); MAP_Stratos.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Capacity bump request & soft-throttle guardrails — need billing + ops confirmation

Karthik / Marcus — forwarding Stratos' ask (below). High level: move 2M -> 5M tokens/mo, start 9/1 preferred, soft-throttle + 10% burst credits. They requested a 6-month ramp.

Karthik: can you confirm proration model (bill pro-rated for remainder of Aug if we go live 9/1?) and the 18% banded discount on delta for first 6 months. Also confirm whether we should route this through an annual commit contract or a 6-month amendment on their existing hosted plan. Please call out any finance approvals needed for the discount.

Marcus: can ops reserve the additional host capacity for the first two weeks of Sept to avoid any cold-start risk? If we need to shift capacity from burst pools please note expected lead time. Also confirm whether the soft-throttle behavior below is operationally implementable on per-route basis (we can supply the MAP from the attachment).

I expect a short sync tomorrow (15m) once you confirm both items; I'll coordinate with Elena on exact start date.

Thanks — Priya

If you can amend the start date to 2026-09-07, we will sign the PO and route the amendment through procurement today. Please send the DocuSign link when the revised amendment is ready.
